t: The Collingwood LED floodlight is a versatile 30W lighting solution, offering variable lumen output for diverse applications. This robust floodlight is suitable for illuminating large outdoor spaces such as courtyards, commercial entrances, or for uplighting trees and buildings. It provides flicker-free, colour-switchable lighting, allowing selection from warm 3000K to bright 6500K white. A wide 120° beam angle and 360° rotation ensure flexible light direction. Constructed with a durable black cast aluminium body and an IP65 rating, it performs reliably in extreme conditions from -40°C to +40°C and is ideal for coastal areas. This wall-mounted unit delivers long-lasting, efficient illumination.
b: Ideal for Coastal Areas & Harsh Environments
